README.md: Single seed-42 split for headline numbers (96 test positives, so recall has SE ~0.03); reduced MLP search (30 random candidates); default 0.5 threshold; see `SUMMARY.md`.
SUMMARY.md: GridSearchCV (Perceptron, LogReg, KNN, SVM) and RandomizedSearchCV (MLP, 30 candidates), 5-fold stratified CV on training data, refit on PR-AUC; all CV metrics recorded. Test set used once afterwards.

6. **Optimizers:** MLP CV PR-AUC: adam .957, SGD(lr 1e-2) .952, L-BFGS .901, SGD(lr 1e-3) .793. [Interpretation] SGD depends mostly on learning rate; Adam and tuned SGD are not distinguishable. LogReg solvers: .8030–.8033 except liblinear .798, i.e. essentially no solver effect on a convex objective. Perceptron configurations: CV PR-AUC .746–.777, CV recall .42–.76.
